limits: Finite noise grid; one global TOA white-noise scale; linear timing model (a nonlinear orbit is linearised at its published values and checked separately); no chromatic process; no noise posterior or survey-wide false-alarm probability.
objective: Timing-marginalised Gaussian objective with covariance determinant; noise grid and circular coefficients profiled separately under null and signal
reference_rule: white-equivalent amplitude at the declared slope
stage: Second-stage joint-noise test of a fixed-noise crossing or a declared development control
threshold: Largest finite-sample order threshold at alpha across the declared generators
